name: Blind Spot
source:
In a futuristic world where smart homes, androids, and space shuttles roam ubiquitously, a man wakes up to a blizzard and a young lady he hardly recognizes.

[From [url=https://polymatheo.itch.io/blind-spot]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在智能家居、机器人和航天飞机无处不在的未来世界中，一名男子在暴风雪中醒来，发现一名他几乎不认识的年轻女子。

[来自[url=https://polymatheo.itch.io/blind-spot]itch.io[/url]]
